---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What's the problem or gap you're running into?**
A clear description of what you can't currently do, or what's awkward to do.

**What would you like to see?**
Describe the feature or change you have in mind.

**Why would this be useful?**
Who would benefit from this and how?

**Have you considered any alternatives?**
Any workarounds you've tried, or other ways this could be solved.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, examples, links, or anything else that helps explain the idea.

---

> **Note:** TF2autoswap is a solo project. Features are prioritised based on the roadmap and available capacity. All suggestions are read and appreciated even if not immediately actioned.
>
> Please do not request features that would enable wallhacks, unfair advantages, or other VAC-unsafe modifications. These will be closed without discussion.
